sanskrit: agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā . sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam somānāṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate . kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
english: May Agni, the priest who is among men, find pleasure in our songs; may he worship the divine folk. O Lord of prayer, make the sound of the soma-pressings resound — he who is Kakṣīvant, son of Uśij.

sanskrit: tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ . tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate agna āyūṃṣi pavase ā suvorjaṃ iṣaṃ ca naḥ . āre bādhasva ducchunām
english: You, O Agni, are widely famed, the beloved, the most excellent priest. Through you they spread out the sacrifice. O Agni, as you purify, pour forth life-force, strength and refreshment for us; drive away misfortune far from us.

sanskrit: vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūrvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi mahi vā kṣatraṃ deveṣu
english: Clothed in forests, like Varuṇa over the rivers, the dispenser of treasures distributes desirable gifts; great indeed is his sovereign power among the gods.

sanskrit: śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvānjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni . tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḍhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte . adruhā devau vardhete
english: O hero of the host, possessing all champions, forceful conqueror — flow pure, winner of wealth. Sharp-weaponed, swift-bowed, unassailable in battles, vanquishing foes in combats — those who rival truth with truth seize vigour and keen power; the two guileless gods grow strong.

sanskrit: urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā purandhī . apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svā3rgāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ . bṛhantaṃ garttamāśāte
english: Creating wide pastures free from fear, the two accordant ones — flow pure together in full wisdom. Seeking the waters, the dawns, and the heavenly light, roar aloud great prizes for us. The rain-heavens, lords of the flowing, gift-laden waters, seize upon the lofty chariot-seat.

sanskrit: tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdhṛtiḥ rocante rocanā divi
english: You slay the obstructing foes without opposition; alone you drive back the enemy, sustaining all people — the shining lights gleam in heaven.

sanskrit: tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe . mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe . śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
english: Now we implore you, O Asura of great wisdom, for wealth and a share of bounty. Like a great hide, your protection, O Indra — may your favours reach us. They yoke his two beloved tawny steeds, bright-winged, to the chariot, ruddy, bold, and man-bearing.

sanskrit: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase . samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
english: Making a signal for the signalless, a form for the formless — O manly one, you were born together with the dawns.

sanskrit: asya yajñasya sukratum tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam
english: You of excellent will for this sacrifice — that which you have made, you have chosen; you have selected the drop, the soma for joy and for the yoke.

sanskrit: apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagnimu śreṣṭhaśociṣam . sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḍayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni . ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta
english: The child of waters, auspicious, brightly blazing, Agni of the finest flame — may he worship for us the grace of Mitra and Varuṇa in the heavens. He is harnessed like a great chariot, abundant-seated, to win many goods; then all human creatures born, seeking the light, have aspired upward toward the forest.

sanskrit: śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ . āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ
english: Vigorous, like the Marut host, flow pure, unreviled, like the divine folk of heaven. Swift as the waters, may your favour be upon us — O soma of a thousand forms, like a sacrifice that overcomes armies.

sanskrit: sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ devebhirmānuṣe jane
english: He is the bringer of perpetual refreshments from the gods to the human folk.

sanskrit: na kirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit . vājo asti śravāyyaḥ sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ . ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca
english: None goes around his power; no one of any kind can. His prize is worthy of acclaim. With your joyful tongues worship the great one at the rite; carry the gods here and worship them.

sanskrit: sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā . viprebhirastu sanitā vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā . agne yajñeṣu sukrato
english: May he, the all-pervading one, be the winner of the prize with his steeds, the conqueror; may he be the winner of wealth through the wise. For you know the paths and roads to the gods directly. O Agni, of good will at sacrifices.

sanskrit: hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaḥ nanakṣe atyo na vājī vidathāni pracodayan
english: The tawny one ran around, born of the sun's trough; like a swift prize-horse he has delighted in the assemblies, urging them on.

sanskrit: saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ . maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yantsaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ vājī vājeṣu dhīyate 'dhvareṣu pra ṇīyate . vipro yajñasya sādhanaḥ
english: Crying out like an infant among its mothers, the bull of many gifts has rushed with the waters. Like a young man going to meet a maiden duly adorned, he flows together with the cows into the jar. The prizewinner is set in place at the prize-contests, led forward at the rites — the inspired one, the accomplisher of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ . mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ dhiyā cakre vareṇyo bhūtānāṃ garbhamā dadhe . dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā
english: The udder of the inviolable cow swells out; the drop, of good wisdom, moves along with the streams. The cows anoint his head with milk in the bowls, as if with gleaming treasures. By prayer the excellent one fashions, takes into himself the embryo of beings — through his lineage, the father of skill.

sanskrit: āpirno bodhi sadhamādye vṛdhe3 'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā na starabhimātaye . asmāṃ citrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya
english: Be our companion in the shared rejoicing, for our growth; may your thoughts protect us. May we be in your good favour, O prize-lord — let us not be overcome by the hostile one who would crush us. Shield us with brilliant aids; lead us into your blessings.

sanskrit: rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham
english: May the river Rasā receive the bull.

sanskrit: te jānata svamokyā3ṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ . mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ
english: They know their own dwelling place; like calves to their mothers they come together, pressing close to one another as kinsmen.

sanskrit: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi . indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ
english: As they graze at the sides of the jaws, they make their support in heaven. Homage and the heavenly light rest in Indra and Agni.

sanskrit: catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ
english: He fashioned four other beautiful worlds for adornment; when he grew strong through the cosmic laws, being just now born he at once crushes down his foes — he whom all the helper-powers rejoice in.

sanskrit: sa bhakṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe . tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti . avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu
english: Tasting the beautiful ambrosia, he has with poetic wisdom parted both heaven and earth. The most fiery waters have wrapped him in their bounty, when they have known the seat of the god by his glory. Growing in might, of manifold strength, he strikes fear into the enemy, the Dāsa; both what is closed and what is open have won — they pour themselves into your inebriant offerings.

sanskrit: te asya santu ketavo 'mṛtyavo 'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu . yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ . svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
english: May those be his banners — immortal, undeceivable — through both births. By them they purify both human power and the divine; from the first they have seized the king with their thoughts. In you all the worlds wrap their will; twice do these appear, thrice do the helpers come. Sweeter than the sweet, release together with the sweet the exhilarating drink; with sweetness meet the honey.

sanskrit: abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram
english: Flowing toward the thought-born hero who stands in the chariot, toward Indra the bull with the thunderbolt-arm — he has exhilarated him to do great deeds, the vast and wide. The true drop follows the god; the true drop follows the true Indra.

sanskrit: abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ . abhi candrā bharttave no hiraṇyābhyaśvānrathino deva soma sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ . dātā rādha stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu pracetana sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram
english: Flow toward the garments of fine clothing, toward the well-milking cows, being purified; flow toward the shining gold to bring to us, toward the horses and chariots, O divine Soma. Born together with sacred will, you have grown with might together, grown strong with heroic deeds, you all-perceiving victor of enemies. O wise one, giver of excellent wealth to the one who praises, you give the desirable good. The true drop follows the god; the true drop follows the true Indra.

sanskrit: abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ . abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ adha tviṣīmāṃ abhyojasā kṛviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe . adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata pra cetaya sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram
english: Flow to us, being purified, toward the divine goods, toward all the earthly goods; flow toward that by which we may attain wealth, toward the heroic like Jamadagni for us. Then the splendid, vigorous one in battle overcame the active one; he filled both worlds; by his greatness he has grown great. He placed another in his belly, having released before — awaken! The true drop follows the god; the true drop follows the true Indra.

sanskrit: tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uto divam
english: By that you spread out the earth; by that you propped up heaven as well.

sanskrit: tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ . tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam
english: From that your sacrifice was born; from that also the hymn and the shout of praise. By that you are the all-encompassing one over all that is born and all that shall be born.

sanskrit: āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi . gharmaṃ na sāmaṃ tapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat
english: You have stirred the ripe within the unripe; you have made the sun ascend in the sky. Glowing like heat, the sāma-hymn — with perfect praises, cherished, great, for the praise-lover.

sanskrit: vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ
english: O bull, your drop is a bull, a prizewinner, the best winner of a thousandfold.

sanskrit: ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ . sahāvāṃ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanaṣāḍamartyaḥ
english: May the exhilarating, bull-like, excellent rapture come to us; O Indra, forceful, winning, victorious in battles, immortal.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham . sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā
english: For you are a hero, a winner; you urge forward the chariot of man. Forceful, you burn the lawless Dasyu like a vessel with your blazing flame.
